panels.description: Mem (Proxmox) = what Proxmox reports as used, including the guest's page cache. Real used = 1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal inside the guest. Cache = reclaimable cache (MemAvailable - MemFree). Pressure = PSI memory some, 5m: % of time at least one task stalled waiting for memory (<1% fine, 1-10% noticeable, >10% too little RAM). Real used, Cache and Pressure only for VMs running node exporter.

targets.expr: sum by (id, name, type) (pve_guest_info{instance="$instance"})
sum by (id) (pve_up{instance="$instance"} and on (id, instance) pve_guest_info)
sum by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_limit{instance="$instance"} and on (id, instance) pve_guest_info)
sum by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{instance="$instance"} and on (id, instance) pve_guest_info)
sum by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{instance="$instance",template!="1"} / pve_memory_size_bytes and on (id, instance) pve_guest_info and on (id) pve_up==1)

max by (id) ((max by (name) (label_replace((1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job=~"node-exporter|node-vms"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job=~"node-exporter|node-vms"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job=~"node-exporter|node-vms"}, "name", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))) * on(name) group_left(id) max by (name, id) (pve_guest_info{instance="$instance"}))

max by (id) ((max by (name) (label_replace((node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job=~"node-exporter|node-vms"} - node_memory_MemFree_bytes{job=~"node-exporter|node-vms"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job=~"node-exporter|node-vms"}, "name", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))) * on(name) group_left(id) max by (name, id) (pve_guest_info{instance="$instance"}))

max by (id) ((max by (name) (label_replace((100 * rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{job=~"node-exporter|node-vms"}[5m])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{job=~"node-exporter|node-vms"}, "name", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))) * on(name) group_left(id) max by (name, id) (pve_guest_info{instance="$instance"}))
sum by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{instance="$instance"} and on (id, instance) pve_guest_info)
sum by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{instance="$instance"} / pve_disk_size_bytes and on (id, instance) pve_guest_info{type="lxc"})

panels.title: Guests memory usage (Proxmox view, includes guest cache)
panels.description: What Proxmox counts as used. For VMs this includes the guest's page cache, so it overstates real use. Real use: 'Memory inside guests' below.

panels.title: $guest
panels.description: Stacked: real used + reclaimable cache + free = RAM the guest sees (shrinks when ballooned). Dashed: what Proxmox reports as used, and the assigned maximum.
